svg.title: Two station clocks disagree while Ghori sleeps beneath them.
svg.desc: At Golmohar Halt, Riju, Vale, Cecil and Babul-da compare two different clock times with a blank digital board. Ghori, the tan station dog, sleeps calmly by the safe marker.
svg.text: Page 15, panel 1 · Wide platform establishing shot beneath the two clocks
